CustomField.description: When the SLA window closes for this work order: Reported DateTime plus the priority-based SLA Target Hours. Formula twin of SLA_Due_Date__c that reads Reported_DateTime__c instead of Reported_Date__c; the old field is retired in the §1 rule 9 DateTime bundle because its _Date suffix asserted a date-only type it never had. Drives SLA_Breached__c and SLA_Health__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date AND time the SLA is due (Reported DateTime + SLA Target Hours). Calculated automatically - the SLA badge turns Breached once the current time passes this value.
CustomField.label: SLA Due DateTime
